claims.statement: TONE3000 is a JUCE 9.0.3 audio plugin (VST3 / AU / CLAP / LV2 / Standalone) that loads Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) captures and impulse responses (IRs) plus a built-in effects suite (Delay/Chorus/Tremolo/Compressor/Reverb/Convolution). The UI is native JUCE (plugin/ui, namespace t3k::ui) — no browser engine; the React/webview build was retired (plugin/docs/native-ui.md). NAM (NeuralAmpModelerCore) and its DSP dependency AudioDSPTools are in-tree under plugin/, hand-populated — Dependencies/ trees are load-bearing.

Build configuration is read at CMake configure time from the repo-root .env (and .env.local override, with the configure environment overriding both) into the generated T3kConfig.h (plugin/ui/NativeUi.cmake, starting from core/T3kConfig.h.in). Required: T3K_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (= t3k_pub_..., the OAuth client_id for sign-in); T3K_API_DOMAIN (default https://www.tone3000.com) and T3K_UPDATE_NOTICE (default off). A `.env` change requires a reconfigure.

The DSP test loop is ./script/test-dsp.sh [gtest-filter]: configure-if-needed → cmake --build build --target DspTests → run build/test/DspTests_artefacts/.../DspTests. The suite compiles the REAL plugin sources (not copies) against the fixtures in test/files/ (NAM A2 captures a2-amp-test.nam / a2-amp-cab-test.nam / a2-am-test-2.nam, cab-ir-test(-2).wav, reverb-ir-mono/stereo-test.wav, em240-gold-plate-5s.wav); from plugin/ui it pulls in only core/Labels.cpp (the KnobScale readout formatter for the scale-contract tests), so a green DspTests does NOT prove the UI links.

Per-repo rules for AI agents live in the repo-root AGENTS.md, an INDEX whose task-specific rules are in docs/agents/*.md: dsp-invariants.md (DSP engines), ui-wiring.md (params/knobs/chains), ir-reverb-training.md (reverb-vs-IR-reference protocol), windows-build.md (MinGW cross-build), linux-build-deep.md, merge-upstream.md, ui-snapshots.md (testbed/goldens). Per-mode DSP laws and every CONSIDERED & DECLINED item in dsp-invariants.md are user-eared contracts to preserve — never silently simplify a law back to a naive form.

Root CMakeLists.txt declares the JUCE 9.0.3 project (C++20), adds the in-tree deps (JUCE via FetchContent, NeuralAmpModelerCore, AudioDSPTools, the googletest test dir), and — for MinGW Windows builds — carries TWO keep-protected patches: T3K_MINGW_DWRITE_CRP (DirectWrite CreateRectFontPalace workaround patch in JUCE) and T3K_MINGW_ASIO_SEH (ASIO SEH exception) — documented in docs/agents/windows-build.md; do not remove these lines.

Windows deliverables are cross-built with MinGW in WSL and staged into C:\\Users\\jambo\\Downloads\\TONE3000-win-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS (run-timestamp folder only, no descriptive suffix, -2/-3 dedup) by scripts/win-standalone.sh; ASIO is a hard dependency; the result is a self-contained PE32+ with no mingw shared-library dependencies (no libstdc++/libgcc/libwinpthread in the DLL import table), verified per docs/agents/windows-build.md.

UI iteration uses the standalone testbed app (plugin/ui/testbed, target UiTestbed) rendering PluginRoot on a fixture-driven MockBackend + MockSession; modes include --scenario (live window), --selftest (unit tests + focus policy in a real window), --capture (2x PNG per scenario), --compare (before/after diff), --bench (CPU/memory phases). It is the acceptance path for UI changes: a green DspTests run does not prove the UI links; verify UI changes in the testbed or a GUI plugin build. -DT3K_BUILD_UI_TESTBED=ON wires --selftest into ctest.

The chain is a left/right lane of blocks (ChainBlock: Nam, IR, Insert, Effect, each with a ChainSide), processed at a fixed 48 kHz base rate (plugin/include/ChainDomain.h, kChainBaseSampleRate = 48000.0) with the host rate re-sampled at the chain's boundary (Lanczos-12). Zero-latency (PDC) is a hard invariant; the NAM engine and the reverb/convolver run inside the chain; effects are in plugin/include/{Delay,Chorus,Tremolo,Compressor,Reverb,ConvolutionReverb}.h.
